guestLine: Alejandro Otálora, Head of Global Design & Product Innovation at Robot.com
description: Robo Radio 13 is live. This month Hello Robo Alejandro Otálora, Head of Global Design & Product Innovation at Robot.com joins Robo Radio 14 to talk about building robots against the odds — and what it takes to design for a world where robots become part of everyday life.
title: Robo Radio 14: Alejandro Otalora
